title: PillarProjectionPayload
description: Source of truth: this schema IS the authoritative shape for Manifest{kind: 'pillar-projection', pillar: 'qahal'} payload_json. Authored as a DHT Manifest entry via create_manifest (existing coordinator function — no new entry type). The substrate reads this payload to derive MechanismSelection projections per (entityType, entityId). Category A (Notarized) via existing Manifest entry type.

mechanism_ladder.description: Mechanism selection configuration for the qahal pillar. Drives the MechanismSelection projection derived from GovernanceState × Content.contentType × Proposal?

settled_states.description: GovernanceState.votingState values that lock content to level 0 (context menu only — no reactions, no graduated feedback, no voting)

mechanism_level_map.description: Maps proposal.votingMechanism to mechanism ladder level (3–7). Keys are votingMechanism string values; values are integer ladder levels.

feedback_inviting_content_types.description: Content type values that invite graduated feedback (level 2) when no active proposal exists. Content types not in this list receive reactions-only (level 1).

default_level_no_proposal.description: Ladder level for content with no active proposal and a contentType not in feedback_inviting_content_types. Defaults to 1 (reactions only).
